user.title: Connect to Ho-Smart receiver
user.description: Enter the receiver address and your Ho-Smart app credentials. Home Assistant uses the account during setup to retrieve the receiver's local-control key and cloud identity. Your Ho-Smart email and password are not saved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Ho-Smart receiver on the local network.
error.invalid_cloud_auth: The Ho-Smart email or password was not accepted.
error.cloud_error: Could not communicate with the Ho-Smart service.
error.no_devices: The Ho-Smart account did not return any receivers.
error.cannot_match_device: The account devices could not be matched to this receiver. Verify the receiver IP address.

abort.already_configured: This Ho-Smart receiver is already configured.

init.title: Ho-Smart connection mode
init.description: Choose how Home Assistant should use this receiver. Hybrid uses local Security1 for receiver state and Ho-Smart cloud history for alarm events. Local only never uses the cloud at runtime. Cloud alarm mode uses Ho-Smart alarm history without local polling.

cloud_credentials.title: Enable Ho-Smart cloud alarms
cloud_credentials.description: This existing entry was created before cloud alarm support. Enter your Ho-Smart app credentials once so Home Assistant can retrieve the account user ID. The email, password and access token are not stored.

error.cannot_match_device: This Ho-Smart account does not contain the receiver already configured in Home Assistant.
